newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AEI signs Ericsson airfreight contract.
newsitem.headline: AEI signs Ericsson airfreight contract.

text.p: Air Express International (AEI) said it has signed an airfreight contract with Swedish telecommunications group, Ericsson.

Sjoerd van Loon, managing director of AEI Netherlands, said the contract involves the airfreight transport and forwarding in and out of Ericsson's five Dutch plants to Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
Van Loon was also the head of Muller Airfreight, which has been working with the Swedish company since 1995. Muller was acquired by AEI late last year.
The Ericsson contract involves around 50 tonnes a year and lasts until the end of 1999, said van Loon.
Ericsson has both production and repair plants in the Netherlands.
Special account managers work on the Ericsson contract, he said.
Major reasons cited by Ericsson for signing up with AEI were the LOGIS track-and-trace system, AEI's world network -- "and we have a pro-active relationship with them", he said.
